description: This file contains unit tests for error handling and exception propagation in Orleans grains, including tests for error scenarios, timing, concurrency, and observer disconnection.

classes.name: ErrorGrainTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing error handling, exception propagation, timing, concurrency, and observer disconnection in Orleans grains.

methods.name: ErrorGrain_GetGrain
methods.description: Tests basic grain reference creation for error testing grains.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingLocalError
methods.description: Tests error handling for locally thrown exceptions outside Orleans grains.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingGrainError1
methods.description: Verifies that grain methods throwing exceptions properly fault their Tasks and propagate errors.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingTimedMethod
methods.description: Tests long-running grain methods without errors, checking timing and completion.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingTimedMethodWithError
methods.description: Tests long-running grain methods that throw errors after a delay, verifying error propagation and timing.

methods.name: StressHandlingMultipleDelayedRequests
methods.description: Stress test with many concurrent delayed grain calls to assess scalability and resource management.

methods.name: ArgumentTypes_ListOfGrainReferences
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of collections of grain references passed as method arguments.

methods.name: AC_DelayedExecutor_2
methods.description: Tests Orleans' delayed execution and scheduling capabilities.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_AsyncMethods
methods.description: Verifies correct handling of async methods in grains for setting and getting state.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_PromiseForward
methods.description: Tests promise forwarding where one grain forwards a call to another.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_GuidDistribution
methods.description: Verifies GUID-based grain ID distribution and hash code spread for load balancing.

methods.description: Helper method to create grain references with specific GUID patterns for distribution testing.

methods.name: ObserverTest_Disconnect2
methods.description: Tests observer disconnection with multiple subscriptions.
